description: Resolve a citation or short title to the canonical legislation.gov.uk item and provision: "Data Protection Act 2018 s. 45", "2018 c. 12", "S.I. 2019/419", "S.S.I. 2020/123", "S.R. 2020/12", "2020 asp 13", "Regulation (EU) 2016/679 art. 28", a legislation.gov.uk URI, or a short title. Returns the item path to pass to uklaw_get_document, and when a provision is given, whether it exists in the current version. A miss or an ambiguous title is a result with found false plus guidance or candidates, not an error. To find legislation by topic or by partial title words rather than a known citation, use uklaw_search_legislation.

citation.description: A citation ("2018 c. 12", "S.I. 2019/419 reg. 5", "Regulation (EU) 2016/679 art. 28"), a short title ("Data Protection Act 2018 s. 45(2)(f)"), or a legislation.gov.uk URI. uklaw_list_reference topic citation_formats lists the accepted forms.

name: uklaw_lookup_citation

attribution.description: Attribution lines the returned content requires (OGL always; EU and Westlaw credits when applicable).

candidates.description: Candidate items (at most 20) when the citation is ambiguous.

document_uri.description: legislation.gov.uk page for the item; present when found.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_refused`: legislation.gov.uk answered 403 or 429 (its fair use rate limit or a block). `pacer_shed`: The shared request queue cannot start this call within its deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when the citation resolved to exactly one item.

guidance.description: What to do next after a miss, ambiguity, or a check that could not run.

id_uri.description: Canonical identifier URI of the item; present when found.

item.description: Canonical item path, e.g. ukpga/2018/12 — pass to uklaw_get_document; present when found.

made_date.description: Date enacted or made (YYYY-MM-DD); absent when not fetched or not reported.

number.description: Item number within the year; present when found.

parsed.description: The citation as the parser read it.

kind.description: How the citation was read: a numbered citation, a short title, a URI, or not readable.

number.description: Number as parsed; for a title, the chapter number when it carries one such as (c. 42).

provision.description: Provision path as parsed, e.g. section/45/2/f; absent when none was cited.

title.description: Short title as parsed; present for kind title.

type.description: Type code the citation maps to, e.g. ukpga, uksi, eur; for a title, present only when it carries a chapter such as (c. 42).

year.description: Year as parsed: a calendar year, or a regnal Monarch/session; absent when none.

provision_found.description: Whether the provision exists in the current version; absent when the check could not run.

provision_path.description: Provision path the citation named, when it named one and the item was found.

provision_uri.description: Identifier URI of that provision, alongside provision_path.

title.description: Item title; absent when it could not be fetched within the call.

type.description: Canonical type code (a Welsh SI cited as uksi comes back as wsi); present when found.

type_label.description: Human label of the type; present when found.

year.description: Calendar year of the item; absent when not known, e.g. a regnal-year item resolved from its path.

title: Resolve a legislation citation
